lines.text: [excited] Power cut... and your Wi-Fi's gone? Not anymore!
Plug in one of these. Twelve and nine volt outputs, plus five volt USB.
Routers, modems, IP cameras, LED strips... all covered.
From about sixty to eighty watt-hours, in twelve or twenty-four volts.
And the slim ones? Just four hundred grams.
[excited] So what would YOU keep running? Drop it in the comments!
